summary: A report on an experiment in which Rand graphic consoles were connected over the ARPANET to UCSB's Online System. The first phase let visitors from UCSB and TRW use it from Rand, and the second phase involved cleaning up the implementation and revisiting strategy.

eli5.summary: Researchers in one city used a drawing screen to work on a computer in another city through the network. They report how it went and what they are fixing.
